questions.question: When men from Judah told Nehemiah about Jerusalem, what shape were the city's wall and gates in?

answers.text: The wall was broken down and the gates were burned
The wall was half built and the gates were locked
The wall was cracked but the gates still stood

questions.question: After hearing bad news about Jerusalem, Nehemiah sat down and wept. True or false?
In his prayer, Nehemiah said Israel had kept all the commandments God gave Moses. True or false?
In his prayer, Nehemiah recalled God's word to Moses. If scattered exiles returned to God and obeyed, what would God do?

answers.text: Gather them and bring them to His chosen place
Bless them right where they were scattered
Raise up a new king to lead them
